description: An elephant-like animal with long curved tusks stands in shallow muddy water at dusk under a stormy sky. Its trunk curls down and grips a clump of green marsh plants while water drips from its mouth. Bare dead trees, reeds and dark swampy ground frame it in an oil-painting style. No text, border or frame is visible.
reason: The animal reads as a generic elephant gripping plants with its trunk; the flat, shovel-shaped lower jaw the card asks for is not clearly visible, so it could be taken for a modern elephant rather than Platybelodon.
